note: Governed catalog of context-COMPRESSION providers for the Baltor/Teleon Compress module and the Context Optimizer stage of the inference plane (compress before route). Distinct from architecture/external_capability_catalog.json's `compression` slot, which catalogs chunk/token compressors (LLMLingua/Headroom/EXIT). This catalog covers PROXY-LEVEL / code-context skeletonizers (TokenTamer) plus the local deterministic compression invariant. TokenTamer is a research_candidate: worth FORKING and hardening (ContextTamer), NOT deploying as-is. Compression here is a DETERMINISTIC TOOL behind the internal LLM plane (explicit base-URL routing + product auth + vault secrets), never a MITM proxy beside it. Connects to: docs/research/tokentamer-context-compression.md, docs/research/context-compression-tools.md, the inference plane (src/teleon/inference), and the agent gateway (compression-as-deterministic-tool).
governance_law: Compression is LOSSLESS-LAW-GOVERNED: per docs/codex/lossless-distillation.md, compression may shrink the TEXT SURFACE only if answer-critical facts + source handles + held-out warnings survive AND a rehydration target exists. Compression is NOT success unless fidelity survives — a smaller payload that drops an answer-critical fact, a source handle, or a held-out warning is a FAILED compression, not a cheaper one. Originals are never overwritten or deleted; every compressed view carries lineage back to the raw layer and a rollback/rehydration path. Compression candidates carry NO truth authority and are never auto-served; LLM/proxy output is never promoted to truth.
savings_governance: Any vendor savings figure (e.g. TokenTamer's 50-80%) is a CLAIM, not a measured result. It is UNVERIFIED until benchmarked on our OWN traces (internal traces + a SWE-bench-lite-style harness) measuring tokens saved, cost delta, latency delta, patch/test pass rate, retry rate, rehydration rate, and false-compression rate. No savings number is repeated as fact in product surfaces until it survives that harness.

entries.technique: proxy-level code-context skeletonization — leaves actively-edited files intact, skeletonizes background code (Python via ast: function/method bodies replaced with `...` keeping signatures/classes; JS/TS/Go/Rust/Java/C#/C/C++ via brace-balance heuristic)
entries.optional_semantic_detection: sentence-transformers embeddings can flag semantically-relevant background files (optional dependency)
entries.mitm_mode_detail: TokenTamer ships an experimental HTTPS-interception mode: a locally generated CA + manual /etc/hosts rewrite of api.openai.com / api.anthropic.com to localhost + manually trusting the CA in the system keystore (a DNS/transport bypass). QUARANTINED: no trusted-CA install, no /etc/hosts rewrite, and no DNS bypass in any shared/CI/hosted deployment. Permitted ONLY as an explicit, documented, single-developer local-dev opt-in, never default, never in the plane.
entries.maturity_evidence: 2 commits, 7 stars, 1 fork, no releases, 100% Python, requires Python 3.10+ (observed 2026-06-08; alpha)
proof_to_promote: Fork (ContextTamer) with the MITM mode removed/quarantined and replaced by EXPLICIT gateway integration (base-URL routing + product auth + vault-referenced secrets); no /etc/hosts, no DNS bypass, no trusted-CA in the deployed path.
Upgrade non-Python skeletonization from brace heuristics to Tree-sitter with PINNED grammar versions (deterministic across runs).
Wrap as a DETERMINISTIC TOOL: no LLM calls at compress time, pinned/stable parser+grammar versions, same input + same version => byte-identical output.
Emit a compression manifest per call (raw handles, what was skeletonized, profile, parser versions, fidelity attestation) and a REHYDRATION tool (given file+symbol, send only that body next turn).
Prove lossless-law compliance: answer-critical facts + source handles + held-out warnings survive; rehydration is demonstrated; originals retained with rollback.

Benchmark on our own traces (SWE-bench-lite-style + internal traces): tokens saved, cost, latency, patch/test pass rate, retry/rehydration rate, false-compression rate — BEFORE any savings number is published or the provider is promoted past research_candidate.

entries.display_name: Local deterministic context skeleton (the compression invariant)
entries.technique: the local, stdlib, deterministic skeletonization/structure-preserving invariant the system always runs — pinned parser versions, no LLM, same input + same version => same output; preserves answer-critical facts, source handles, and held-out warnings; rehydration available
entries.note: the local deterministic compression invariant — the ONE active compression provider; external proxy/skeletonizer candidates (TokenTamer) must match this contract before promotion and never become the wired authority by being installed beside the plane

conservative.description: Skeletonize only clearly-background files far from the active edit set; keep wide context. Lowest false-compression risk; smallest savings. Default for cheap routes and ambiguous context.

balanced.description: Skeletonize background files; keep active files + semantically-flagged neighbors intact. Default for general routes.

aggressive.description: Skeletonize all non-active files and prune low-signal neighbors; rely on the rehydration tool to fetch bodies on demand. Highest savings; reserved for premium/large-context routes with rehydration enabled and the fidelity gate watched.

deterministic_tool.note: Compression is exposed as a deterministic tool (Context Optimizer between policy and router in the inference plane, and as a deterministic tool in the agent gateway): no LLM at compress time, pinned/stable parser+grammar versions, byte-stable output for the same input+version, and a rehydration tool so any skeletonized body can be fetched on the next turn.
